title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar, Que New Collection | Autumn Sparkle | Allied Brass
description:
Add dependable towel storage to your bathroom with this 30-Inch wall mount towel bar made from solid brass in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. Designed for the Que New collection, it coordinates easily with versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware while keeping towels organized at the sink or shower.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Straight bar design
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors
- Installation hardware included (towel bar, mounting plates, and hardware)

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.5 inches
- Projection: 3 inches
- Overall dimensions: 33 inches W x 3 inches H x 3 inches projection
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
